summary.text: Brandi Bradley is a Republican member of the Colorado House of Representatives from District 39 who took office on January 9, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes working in physical therapy.

paragraphs.text: Brandi Bradley earned a bachelor's degree from Middle Tennessee State University and a master's degree in physical therapy from Regis University.
Her career experience includes working in physical therapy.
Bradley was unopposed in the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Christian Schilder in the general election.

For 2025 and 2026 she was assigned to the Health and Health Services Committee, the State, Civic, Military, and Veterans Affairs Committee, the Colorado Health Insurance Exchange Oversight Committee and the Statutory Revision Committee.
